headline: No material India-specific AI regulatory change surfaced this period; prioritise monitoring the telecom proposal rather than AI compliance action.

body.text: The only regulatory development identified is TRAI’s low-relevance proposal for 5G network-slice notices, capacity and QoS requirements from 1 October 2026, alongside outage reporting and subscriber rebates.
It is telecom-focused and does not introduce an AI-specific requirement for OpenAI on the information available.

notes: 118 developments qualified; the model was shown the newest 60
selection: dated or first seen within the last 14 days
